reference.title: Opc Ua Client Alarm Manager
reference.shortdesc: This manager is the default view of the client alarms device extension (OpcUaClientAlarmDeviceExt) as well as the server alarms device extension (OpcUaServerAlarmDeviceExt).

section.p: This view allows you to scan the OPC UA server to discover and subscribe to OPC UA alarm events. For more information, refer to “Opc Ua Server Alarm Manager.”
